notification.title: Notifications
notification.description: Things waiting for you and changes to your account show up here. Read notifications are removed after the retention period.

event.title: Event notifications
event.description: The system notifies the people involved when these events happen. Turning a channel off stops future deliveries; notifications already sent are kept, and turning it back on does not resend them.
event.mandatory: Security related, cannot be turned off

approvalPending.name: Request awaiting review
approvalPending.description: Notifies reviewers when someone submits a request (account registration, folder access).
approvalPending.recipients: People holding the “Review requests” permission at submission (excluding the requester)

approvalResult.name: Request reviewed
approvalResult.description: Notifies the requester when a request is approved or rejected. Email is the existing review result email.

userRolesChanged.name: Roles changed
userRolesChanged.description: Notifies a user when roles are assigned to or removed from them.
